task.name: menu bars and context menus
task.prompt: Complete menubar.css and zui.js: traditional File/Edit/View/Help menu, keyboard access (Alt, arrows), accelerators/mnemonics, checkable and disabled items, submenus, right-click context menus sharing the same renderer. Requirement: menus are fully keyboard-operable and emit channel messages.

task.name: loading and progress indicators
task.prompt: Finalise loading.css: small spinner (sizes), determinate and indeterminate thin progress bars, skeleton placeholder rows, reduced-motion support, zui.js helpers to bind progress to host events. Requirement: no flashy animation; matches design.txt restraint.

task.name: notification glyphs and toasts
task.prompt: Complete notification.css: badges (count/dot/warn/error), inline status glyphs, and an understated toast stack with kinds (ok/warn/error) and auto-dismiss. zui.js toast queue and host push channel. Requirement: notifications never dominate the UI; toast stack is compact and corner-anchored.

task.name: text inputs and form fields
task.prompt: Flesh out input.css and zui.js: text/search/number inputs, textarea, labelled fields, validation states (error/warn) with messages, inline rename-in-place, compact desktop sizing. Requirement: forms match design.txt (no giant/mobile inputs); validation is token-driven.

task.name: tables and lists
task.prompt: Complete table.css and zui.js: compact rows, subtle separators, sortable and resizable columns, single/multi/shift/ctrl selection, functional row states only, a virtualised rendering hook for large datasets. Requirement: a 10000-row track table scrolls smoothly and matches design.txt.

task.name: checkboxes, radios and toggles
task.prompt: Add form-control CSS and behaviour: checkbox (incl. indeterminate), radio groups, and a restrained toggle switch used only where function calls for one. Requirement: controls are compact, accent-driven, keyboard operable, consistent across hosts.

task.name: sliders and range controls
task.prompt: Add a slider/range component (CSS and zui.js): horizontal value slider, dual-thumb range, tick support, keyboard steps; used for playback scrub and volume. Requirement: restrained desktop styling, token-driven, emits value on the message bus.

task.name: tree view navigation
task.prompt: Add a tree/outline component for sidebar hierarchies (LIBRARY, PLAYLISTS): expand/collapse, keyboard nav, single/multi select, drag to reorder, rename-in-place. Requirement: the showcase sidebar uses the tree component and matches design.txt SIDEBAR rules.

task.name: modal dialogs and popovers
task.prompt: Add dialog/popover primitives (CSS and zui.js): modal dialog with title/body/footer buttons, non-modal anchored popover, focus trap, Esc/Enter handling, overlay. Requirement: dialogs are compact native-style (not large rounded web cards) and manage focus correctly.

task.name: status / device bar
task.prompt: Build the persistent status/device bar as a reusable component: disconnected (neutral) vs connected (accent) states, device name/capacity/free, consistently aligned Eject/Sync actions, driven by a device host channel. Requirement: matches the STATUS / DEVICE BAR example in design.txt.

task.name: playback / contextual control bar
task.prompt: Build the compact contextual control bar (playback bar for the music app): prev/play/pause/stop/next icon buttons, artwork, track text, time, scrub progress, shuffle/repeat toggles, visually secondary to the workspace. Requirement: matches PLAYBACK BAR in design.txt and is generic enough for non-music hosts.

task.name: iconography set
task.prompt: Assemble a small consistent monochrome line-icon set (SVG sprite) for nav, menus, buttons, status; document sizing/weight rules; no emoji as app icons. Requirement: all showcase icons come from the sprite and share visual weight per design.txt ICONOGRAPHY.

task.name: theme system and design tokens
task.prompt: Formalise the theming layer: document every token in tokens.css, the data-zui-theme contract, a theme-authoring guide, and runtime zui.setTheme with a host theme channel. Ship holo (light) complete and a holo-dark draft. Requirement: a new theme can be added as one CSS file with zero component changes.

task.name: interaction and keyboard layer
task.prompt: Implement the shared interaction behaviours from design.txt: context menus, double-click actions, drag and drop, global shortcuts incl. Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y, Tab order, multi/shift/ctrl selection helpers, tooltips, rename-in-place. Requirement: behaviours are centralised in zui.js and reused by every component.

task.name: showcase app: full component gallery
task.prompt: Expand the showcase into a complete navigable gallery: one section per component with live examples, all states, code snippets, a theme switcher, and a realistic music-browser mock screen assembled only from zUI parts. Requirement: every shipped component appears in the showcase and matches design.txt.

task.name: host integration examples
task.prompt: Add runnable minimal host samples: a WinForms/WPF C# app and a Win32 C++ app that each open the showcase through their binding and round-trip a few messages (theme, device, selection, save). Requirement: both samples build via build.ps1 and show identical UI.
